children: The tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite is staging a nascent rebound.

The Nasdaq is outperforming the Dow Jones Industrial Average by 3.1 percentage points over the last two trading days, the largest such outperformance since May 2025, according to Dow Jones Market Data.
This item is part of a Wall Street Journal live coverage event. The full stream can be found by searching P/WSJL (WSJ Live Coverage).
